game.name: Gunstringer, The (USA, Europe)
game.desc: The Gunstringer is a shooting and platforming game for the Xbox 360 compatible with the famous Kinect motion sensor. Controlling a cowboy puppet with his left hand, the player uses his right hand as a gun to shoot anything that moves. Numerous enemies and fearsome bosses set in original settings will give us a lot of trouble throughout a fresh and dynamic adventure.
